blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Education Secretary Sonny Angara led the expansion of the Department of Education’s (DepEd) nationwide mental health and well-being initiatives, coinciding with the nationwide observance of Mental Health Awareness Month and National School Safety Week. The initiative featured a Mental Health Caravan held at Marikina Elementary School, organized in collaboration with the National Center for Mental Health (NCMH) and key advocacy partners, along with the mass oath-taking in Makati City of 339 newly appointed School Counselor Associates (SCAs) in the National Capital Region (NCR).
